summary_1line: Yudhishthira questions Bhishma on worthy recipients of gifts and priestly conduct, leading to teachings from Earth, Kasyapa, Agni, and Markandeya on virtue and truth.

image_candidates.scene_text: The goddess Earth, Rishi Kasyapa, Agni blazing in human form, and the sage Markandeya speak together before Yudhishthira as Bhishma recounts their words.
A clod of mud dissolves into the vast ocean as the Earth-goddess explains how sin vanishes through sacred duties.
A cosmic balance weighs a thousand horse-sacrifices on one side and the shining symbol of Truth on the other.
